title: LiveSycn UNreal - CLO3d
content:
LiveSycn Unreal - CLO3d I am currently using the free trial of clo3d and wanted to try the livesync of clo3d with unreal, but my connection status is never tunring green is this due to the free trial ? can someone help me ? Thanks a lot!![05bba3b0de7b42ba9a3bd1896bb5c1b3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/55490cbfb1df4a83b8ca6588b300248e/images/05bba3b0de7b42ba9a3bd1896bb5c1b3clounreal.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: thank you!! but i don't have the animation and livesync tab

Comment 2: Unreal 5.5.4CLO 2025.0.252
Reply 1: I was not able to replicate the issue, however, the connection issue should be addressed in the upcoming CLO patch release. You would just need to enable LiveSync in User Settings. This particular setting will be available after the patch release.

Comment 3: Hi yanick.horat,Thank you for trying out CLO and CLO LiveSync! I'm thinking that it could be a version compatibility issue but I want to be sure - could you let me know which version of CLO you are using? 🙂 The version number at the bottom left of the screenshot is not legible.Best regards,Bryan

title: Connect Store pending issue
content:
Hi, I'm new here and trying to upload my design to the Connect Store—how long does "Pending" usually take? Mine seems stuck.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: I think the long "pending" is caused by a problem with the item being uploaded, usually there will be a notification sent from the website for details of the problem.

Comment 2: Hi. From Friday to Sunday, the checking and uploading of designs will not be carried out by the site. Evaluations will resume starting from Monday
content_description: This page aims to provide guidance and support for users experiencing delays in the design upload process to the Connect Store.
